text: そこを　バッチリ　みせちゃう　からね！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is a casual squeezed form of てしまう. Here it means going ahead and doing it fully. みせちゃう = 'I'll go ahead and show'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a sentence gives a reason or a firm promise; ね asks for agreement. みせちゃうからね = 'I'm going to show you, okay!'.
